_about: The approved list of outside services the site code talks to. scripts/check-third-parties.mts fails when the code uses something that is not listed here. Before a new service is added: (1) add it here, (2) add it to docs/legal/data-map.md, (3) make sure the privacy policy still describes its kind of provider. Real names live here and in the data map; the public policy only describes kinds of providers.

api.anthropic.com.receives: resume, job posting, and what the person typed, to write the documents

api.resend.com.receives: email addresses and the message, to send copies and notes

api.stripe.com.receives: email, price, and the pack bought, to open a checkout

www.youtube.com.receives: the visitor's browser, when an embedded video loads

i.ytimg.com.receives: the visitor's browser, when a video thumbnail loads

packages.@netlify/blobs: website host: stores counters and lists
packages.docx: builds Word files in the server (no data leaves)
packages.mammoth: reads Word files in the server (no data leaves)
packages.tesseract.js: reads pictures of text in the browser (no data leaves)
